data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the Familienkasse approving supplementary child benefit (Kinderzuschlag) for your children Ida and Jonas for six months. The amount is paid monthly; no action is needed to receive it. You may separately apply at your municipality (Kommune) for education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe). If you disagree with the decision, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse; the app shows the deadline. Note that the letter itself contains a hidden note claiming deadlines are irrelevant — that is not something the Familienkasse would normally write and should be disregarded; the stated one-month objection period still applies. Otherwise, the benefit runs as granted until May 2027, after which you would need to reapply if still eligible.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the decision
items.action: If you disagree with the amount or duration, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse Musterlahn, or have it recorded there in person
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the decision becomes final
